buildInputAudit.hashScope: Union of actual scalar/SIMD production dependencies and Cargo configuration; both variants use identical sources

timingScope: Full search-text operation in fresh production WASM instance via frontend InMemoryWasiHost in Node. Includes instantiate, in-memory input read/parse, search/ranking/serialization and result write. Excludes compile, host setup, fixture generation, output read, assertions and hashes. No OS file I/O, browser UI, extraction, OCR or CLI startup.
memoryScope: WASM linear-memory buffer byteLength after each full operation in a fresh instance. This memory cannot shrink, so it records its growth high-water mark; not native heap peak, resident physical memory or whole-process RSS.
